thesis: Mishra’s Workshop compressed three turns of artifact mana into one land drop, making the deck-building restriction a source of explosive tempo and long-term format identity.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Workshop decks evolved from early artifact acceleration into Stax, prison, and Ravager Shops, becoming one of Vintage’s permanent strategic pillars.

playbook.role: Maximize artifacts and cast lock pieces or threats before the opponent can deploy efficient answers. Opening hands should be judged by whether Workshop mana converts immediately into a coherent battlefield.
